svg.title: X for X-Banner and Frame Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold X gains crossed frame rods and a portrait banner with four corner attachments. The graphic appears on the banner, and the X moves left as the X-Banner and Frame Design heading and examples of artwork, frame and display appear.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop. X shape and violet, near-black, cream and coral palette adapted from 24_X_xr_experiences.png. All graphics, animation and typography embedded; illustrative frame, not an engineering specification.
